title: Install the Tailscale app
description: First, download and install the Tailscale application on your computer. You can get the latest version from the official website at https://tailscale.com/download. Follow the setup wizard until the app is installed successfully.

title: Enable the Network Extension
description: Go to System Settings → Privacy & Security → Network Extension and enable Tailscale so it can access the required network features.

title: Open Tailscale settings
description: Click the Tailscale icon in the menu bar at the top of your screen, then select 'Settings' or 'Tailscale Settings' from the dropdown.

title: Enable CLI Integration
description: In the Tailscale settings, scroll down to the 'CLI Integration: Manage Tailscale from terminal' section and click 'Show me how'.

title: Install the Tailscale CLI
description: When the modal appears, click the button to install Tailscale CLI at /usr/local/bin/tailscale. Once installed, you'll be able to manage Tailscale directly from the terminal.
